verbatim_extracts.label: Intra-pipeline 4-state issue-ledger vocabulary (per ADR-0008) — for the 5-state ADR's parallel-but-distinct citation
verbatim_extracts.text:
## Lifecycle states

| Status | Meaning | Set by |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | Issue is active; needs resolution | Reviewer that surfaces it |
| `resolved` | Issue is fixed; reviewer confirmed | Reviewer at iteration N+1 after fix at iteration N |
| `wontfix-with-rationale` | Issue acknowledged but deliberately not fixed; rationale recorded | User (via orchestrator AskUserQuestion) only |
| `superseded` | Issue replaced by a different one (typically because the underlying design changed) | Reviewer; references the superseding issue ID |

`wontfix-with-rationale` requires user approval — a reviewer alone cannot move an issue to this status. The orchestrator surfaces the issue to user, captures the rationale, and updates the ledger.

## Transitions

```
                ┌────────────┐
   created  ───►│    open    │───► resolved
                └────────────┘     (terminal)
                       │
                       ├────────► wontfix-with-rationale (user-approved)
                       │           (terminal)
                       │
                       └────────► superseded (by issue I-XX-NNN)
                                   (terminal)
```

No transition out of any terminal state. If a "resolved" issue re-appears, it gets a NEW ID — and the reviewer must reference the prior ID as `references_prior: I-XX-NNN` in the new issue.
verbatim_extracts.implications_for_design: The 4 states are: open, resolved, wontfix-with-rationale, superseded. The new 5-state issue-* vocabulary (draft → open → adopted | complete | superseded | wontfix-with-rationale) shares THREE state-name strings (open, superseded, wontfix-with-rationale) with this intra-pipeline vocabulary BUT operates on a distinct entity (Issues/<topic>/<doctype>.md files vs. issues-ledger.json records) with distinct ID prefixes (I-<DR|AA|CA>-NNN vs. <DOCTYPE>-<topic-slug>). The PRD §Product Policy Decisions row 2 establishes the parallel-but-distinct policy; the ADR for the 5-state vocabulary (per PRD U-10) must transcribe THIS verbatim text and contrast against it.
